chapter: Telephone reels: blues and Bessie Smith
title: The Ethel Waters record and 'Empty Bed Blues'
summary: Johnson still has the original Ethel Waters record; Rasch asks about 'Empty Bed Blues' and the tape becomes untranscribable.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens

blocks.x: Noodling. That's what J.C. calls noodling. I got to ask a question backwards aways. Ethel Waters and you put together that first record. You weren't going to play it but the musicians took off so you did.
Did that record take off, J.C.
I have the original record, I have it. (Inaudible) it came to me.
That's your first. What about Empty Bed Blues. Bessie Smith.
Empty Bed Blues, because I was reading the information Sunny gave me and that's the biggie, the one that everyone stands up and says if anybody knows what jazz is --
